name: Seasonal Picks
description: Picks movies from your watch history and the time of year.
overview: History- and calendar-aware movie picks as playlists (works on TV), a shared Suggested library, themed seasonal covers and a web Suggested screen.

versions.changelog: Seasonal Picks now has its own entry in the dashboard side menu. New look for the settings page: tabs, a header showing what's on today and what's next, and seasons that fold up into a one-line summary with a cover thumbnail. The Save buttons stay at the bottom of the screen while you scroll. This changelog, under What's new.
